earnings.title: October 22, 2026
highlights: Net sales were $11.3 billion, up 13% year-over-year, reflecting increases in all operating segments.
GAAP earnings per share (EPS) was $0.62; operating EPS 1 was $0.71, compared to a loss of $0.19 in the year-ago period.
EPS excludes significant items totaling $0.09 per share, primarily driven by costs associated with the Company’s collective self-help actions.
Free cash flow 1 was $1.1 billion, with trailing twelve-month cash flow conversion 1 of 84%.

quotes.text: Dow delivered a solid third quarter, driven by targeted downstream growth and disciplined execution against an evolving macro backdrop.
We are building a more resilient and competitive Dow that is positioned to create long-term value through our continued focus on three priorities.
